title: App Shell · Auth · Routing · API Client · Design System

tasks.title: Top bar with global search
acceptance: Logo links to /home
⌘K opens global search modal scoped to: products, SKUs, issues, connectors, submissions
Search results grouped by type with result count per group
Notifications bell shows unread count badge from GET /api/v1/notifications
User avatar menu: profile, switch tenant, log out (POST /api/v1/auth/logout)
tasks.notes: Logo must use alt text for screen readers.

tasks.title: Left sidebar with dynamic badges
acceptance: Desktop ≥1280px: persistent expanded sidebar. Collapsible to icon strip — preference saved via useLocalStorage (R12)
Tablet 768–1279px: collapsed icons by default, tap to expand as overlay
Mobile <768px: sidebar hidden. Bottom tab bar shows: Home, Catalog, Issues, Channels, Settings (R15)
Issues badge: count from GET /api/v1/issues?severity=error&status=open
Channels badge: amber dot when any ConnectorInstallation.status === CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED
Submissions badge: count of PENDING submissions
Active route: accent color left border

tasks.title: Login page with rate limit and lockout states
acceptance: API returns 429: replace form with 'Too many attempts' message + countdown from Retry-After header
API returns 423 with ACCOUNT_LOCKED: show masked email (first 2 chars + *** + @domain) and 'Resend unlock email' link
POST /api/v1/auth/resend-unlock called on link click. Shows 'Email sent' on success
Password field NOT rendered when account is locked
API returns 401 with attemptsRemaining ≤ 2: show 'Forgot password?' link inline
All strings use i18n keys (R2)

tasks.title: ConnectionStatusBar + offline state setup
acceptance: 4px strip at top of viewport: invisible when online, gray when navigator.onLine false
useOnlineStatus hook: isOnline, showOfflineBanner (fires after 30s offline)
Yellow dismissible banner after 30s offline: uses i18n key K.offlineBanner
2-second green 'Back online' flash on reconnect

gateCheck: Sidebar collapses to icon strip and preference persists across page reload
GET /api/v1/issues?severity=error&status=open count appears correctly in Issues badge
Login with wrong credentials 5× → account locked screen shown with masked email
Disable wifi in browser devtools → gray connection strip appears immediately
axe-core passes zero violations on /login and /(app)/home pages

title: Product List · Product Detail · Completeness · Media Upload

tasks.title: Product list with completeness ring and channel badges
acceptance: Fetches GET /api/v1/products with cursor pagination, default 50 rows (R5)
CompletenessRing SVG arc with role='img' and aria-label per R10. Score text inside arc.
Click ring → opens CompletenessBreakdownPanel slide-over
Channel badges per ConnectorSlug. Multi-account: show highest severity (REJECTED>PENDING>WARNING>SUCCESS). Tooltip shows per-account breakdown when installationCount > 1
PENDING badges use animate-pulse-badge class (R9). Badge auto-refresh every 15s while any PENDING
Badge 'not connected' when no installation exists for that connector
Add Product toolbar button shows amber badge when skus >= 80% of plan limit from usePlanUsage
Loading: skeleton rows (8). Empty: EmptyStatePanel. Error: retryable banner

tasks.title: Filter drawer with URL persistence
acceptance: All active filters in URL query params (shareable link)
Filter drawer: slides from right on mobile, inline on desktop
Filter chip strip below toolbar: active filters with individual × close

Filters: search text, category multi-select, status, completeness range slider with presets (<50, 50–79, ≥80), missing image toggle, channel readiness, has issues toggle, recently updated, submission status

tasks.title: Media library page
acceptance: Grid/list view toggle. Upload CTA prominent.
Asset detail drawer: dimensions, file size, mimeType, cdnUrl, checksum, upload date
Cursor-based pagination (R5)
Cloudflare CDN warning if asset lastVerifiedAt > 24h old

tasks.title: Product detail header with save and offline state
acceptance: Header is sticky (z-index above tabs)
Inline title editing: click text → input, blur/enter triggers save
⌘S keyboard shortcut triggers save
Save states: idle button → 'Saving…' spinner → 'Saved ✓' (2s) → idle. On error: 'Save failed — retry' button (R11)
Offline + unsaved changes: 'Offline — will save on reconnect' state. Auto-retry on reconnect (useOnlineStatus hook)
React Router useBlocker: prompt 'You have unsaved changes' on navigate-away when isDirty (useUnsavedChanges hook)
Channel badges in header poll every 10s while PENDING. Pulse animation (R9)

tasks.title: Overview tab with completeness blockers panel
acceptance: All core fields: title, description, brand, category picker, hsnCode, gstRate select, mrp, sellingPrice, colour, size
mrp >= sellingPrice validation, hsnCode 6 or 8 numeric digits, title max 200 chars
CompletenessBreakdownPanel: fields sorted by potential score gain desc. Each missing field has Fix link (scroll or tab switch)
Field weights from COMPLETENESS.weights in tokens.ts

tasks.title: Media tab with cloud upload
acceptance: Drag-reorder: reorder updates Product.mainImageId when slot 0 changes
Upload via POST /api/v1/media/upload multipart with progress bar
Client-side validation: JPEG/PNG/WebP only, max 10MB before upload
After upload: poll GET /api/v1/media/:id until cdnUrl present
Connector rules shown as info chips: Amazon 1000×1000 min, Flipkart 500×500, Meesho 800×800 square
HTTP 402 on upload → PlanLimitModal (R6)

tasks.title: CompletenessRing accessibility (fix during initial build)
acceptance: role='img' on SVG. aria-label: 'Completeness: {score} out of 100. {Good/Needs work/Incomplete}.' (R10)

gateCheck: GET /api/v1/products with 100 seeded products: list renders in <300ms, correct channel badges shown

Edit product title, navigate away → 'You have unsaved changes' prompt appears

Upload image > 10MB → client-side error before request sent

title: Channels Overview · Connector Install Flows · Connector Audit

tasks.title: Connector overview with live status badges
acceptance: Fetches GET /api/v1/connectors/installed. Polls every 30s
One ConnectorCard per installation (not per slug) when multi-account exists
CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED: amber border, prominent Reconnect CTA
Capability chips from ConnectorInstalled.capabilities
ONDC card: greyed-out 'Coming soon' with 'Architecture in progress' tooltip. No Connect CTA.
Submission success rate from GET /api/v1/submissions/stats?installationId={id}&days=30

tasks.title: Multi-account badge state (must be built before badge component finalised)
acceptance: ChannelBadge.installationCount > 1: badge shows highest severity from BADGE_SEVERITY map in tokens.ts
Hover tooltip on multi-account badge: shows per-account status breakdown using accountAlias as label
Product list channel badge: severity ranking applied. Single installation: unchanged behavior
Channels overview: ConnectorCard shows accountAlias badge when multiple installations exist for same slug
Product detail Channels tab: segmented tabs per installation when count > 1. Default active tab = most severe status

tasks.title: Amazon OAuth install flow (5 steps)
acceptance: Step 1–2: informational. 'Start connection' calls GET /api/v1/auth/amazon/start
Step 3: opens Amazon consent URL in new tab. Parent polls GET /api/v1/connectors/installed until ACTIVE or 5min timeout
Step 4: auto-handled. 'Verifying credentials…' spinner
Step 5 success: masked sellerId, ACTIVE badge, 'Validate a product' next steps
Step 5 failure: error reason from failureReason field, 'Try again' button
CSRF state param verified server-side. UI surfaces error if state mismatch.

tasks.title: Meesho credential form (not OAuth)
acceptance: 'Test connection' calls POST /api/v1/connectors/meesho/test-credentials with { merchantId, secretKey }
On success: calls POST /api/v1/connectors/meesho/install. Shows ACTIVE state.
Capability strip explicitly omits PUBLISH chip
Inline note uses K.meeshoCapNote i18n key. Never mentions 'Publish'.

gateCheck: Install Amazon connector: OAuth flow completes, installation shows ACTIVE status
Two Amazon accounts installed: channels page shows two separate ConnectorCards with different accountAlias labels
Product list badge for two-account Amazon with PENDING (India) + SUCCESS (UAE): badge shows PENDING
Meesho capability strip contains VALIDATE and EXCEL_EXPORT. PUBLISH chip is absent.
axe-core zero violations on /channels and /channels/[slug]

SourceLabel visible on readiness score: LIVE_API / LOCAL_RULES / NOT_VALIDATED (R8)
Meesho: 'Generate export file' CTA only. Never 'Publish' (R4)

tasks.title: Issue inbox table

IssueChip renders sellerMessage. Raw code in tooltip only (R3)
SourceLabel on every row (R8)
'Jump to field' constructs deep link /catalog/{productId}?tab=attributes&field={fieldPath}

gateCheck: Product with Amazon LIVE_API validation: SourceLabel shows 'Live API' on Channels tab readiness score
Product with two Amazon installations: Channels tab shows segmented tabs. Most severe active by default.
Issue inbox: click 'Jump to field' for hsnCode error → opens product detail at Attributes tab with hsnCode field focused

tasks.title: Bulk action bar

'N products selected' count with deselect all ×

tasks.title: Meesho export flow with partial success state
acceptance: Step 1: product selection with count
Step 2 (POST /api/v1/connectors/meesho/export): export summary BEFORE download button
Summary: '{n} products included · {m} excluded'. Excluded list with reason + 'Fix →' deep link per product

Row click: DetailDrawer on right (no page nav)

Expandable row: payloadSnapshot read-only JSON viewer with syntax highlight
Attempt number badge when attemptNumber > 1

Channel errors as IssueChip (sellerMessage + fieldPath). Raw codes in tooltip only (R3)
Attempt timeline with idempotencyKey (truncated)

title: Notifications · Home Dashboard · Plan Limits UI · Settings Plan

tasks.title: In-app notification panel
acceptance: Bell icon in TopBar with unread count badge. Click opens slide-over panel.
PLAN_LIMIT_WARNING: amber ⚠ icon. Dismissible. Action 'View plan' → /settings/plan
PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: red ✕ icon. NOT dismissible until plan upgraded or usage drops.
CONSENT_REQUIRED: blue 🔒 icon. NOT dismissible. Sticky at TOP of panel. Blocks page until re-consent given. (R17)
Standard events (rejection, credential expiry): dismissible, action links

tasks.title: Home readiness summary strip
acceptance: Fetches GET /api/v1/dashboard/readiness. Polls every 60s.
Three cards: Amazon · Flipkart · Meesho. Each: ready (green), blocked (red), pending (indigo) counts
Meesho card: no pending count (export-only). Shows 'Export-ready' and 'Blocked' only
notConnected: true → dimmed card with 'Connect {name}' CTA → navigates to /channels
Count chips: asOf tooltip shows relative time ('as of 2 minutes ago')
Plan limit >80% for submissions: amber 'Nearing limit' chip with /settings/plan link

tasks.title: Home attention needed panel
acceptance: Priority-ordered list: expired credentials, rejected listings, blocked products, failed bulk jobs
Plan limit ≥80% for any resource: prepended at priority 0 with amber icon
CONSENT_REQUIRED: prepended as non-dismissible red item at priority -1
Panel hidden when no action items
Each item is a link to the relevant page/action

tasks.title: Plan limit 402 handling + upgrade flow
acceptance: PlanLimitModal registered in root (app)/layout.tsx via registerPlanLimitHandler()
POST /api/v1/products returns 402 → PlanLimitModal shown. Never generic toast. (R6)
'Upgrade plan' → /settings/plan. 'Maybe later' → dismiss, action cancelled.
Product list toolbar: amber badge on 'Add product' when skus ≥ 80% of limit. Tooltip: '{current} of {limit} SKUs used'
Media upload zone: warning banner when storageGb > 90% of limit
usePlanUsage hook fetches GET /api/v1/billing/usage on mount, caches 5 min

tasks.title: Plan & usage meters (moved from P6-S3)
acceptance: Fetches GET /api/v1/billing/usage via usePlanUsage hook (no duplicate fetch)
Progress bars for: SKUs, submissions, storageGb, users. Color: green <80%, amber 80–95%, red >95%
Billing cycle reset date: 'Resets on {date}' below submissions meter
Upgrade CTA visible when ANY meter ≥ 80%
Upgrade CTA links to /settings/plan (internal). External pricing URL is on that page itself.
Enterprise plan: no limits shown. 'Unlimited' label.

tasks.title: Notifications settings — plan and DPDP event types

PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED row: 🔒 icon, cannot be disabled
CONSENT_REQUIRED row: 🔒 icon, cannot be disabled

gateCheck: CONSENT_REQUIRED notification: cannot be dismissed. Sticky at top of notification panel.
POST /api/v1/products returns 402: PlanLimitModal shown with correct resource name. No toast appears.
Plan usage page: progress bars correct for SMOKE tenant. Resets date shown.

title: DPDP Consent · Data Export · Account Erasure
notes: LEGAL REQUIREMENT. Must ship before Growth tier self-serve is enabled.

tasks.title: Consent screen at onboarding
acceptance: Full-page step (not modal). Step label: 'Data & Privacy'
Three plain-English paragraphs: what we collect, how we use it, your rights. NO legalese.
Checkbox UNCHECKED by default (R16). 'Continue to PIM1' disabled until ticked.
'I don't consent — delete my account' link visible. Calls DELETE /api/v1/account on confirm. Redirects to /goodbye.
On consent: POST /api/v1/auth/consent with { consentVersion: N }
consentRequired: true in auth response → redirect to consent step regardless of nav target (R17)
Font size ≥ 14px, line-height ≥ 1.6 on consent text
All strings use i18n keys (R2). Hindi translation required for Phase 7.

tasks.title: Data export and account erasure in Settings
acceptance: 'Data & Privacy' nav item in Settings sidebar between Notifications and Plan & Usage
'Export my data' button → POST /api/v1/account/export. Button becomes 'Export in progress…' on 202.
Inline note: 'We'll email you a download link within 30 minutes'
Last export timestamp shown if exists
'Delete my account' → opens DeleteAccountModal
Modal: type-to-confirm email field. Delete button disabled until email matches exactly (case-sensitive). (R16)
On confirm DELETE /api/v1/account: show 'Deletion scheduled by {completesBy}'. User NOT logged out.
Consent record shown: 'You consented on {date} (version {N})'. Link to policy.
All strings use i18n keys (R2)

gateCheck: Complete onboarding without ticking consent checkbox: 'Continue' button remains disabled
Tick checkbox + continue: POST /api/v1/auth/consent called. Navigates to /home.
'I don't consent' → confirmation modal → DELETE /api/v1/account called → redirected to /goodbye
Delete account modal: type wrong email → delete button stays disabled. Type correct email → enabled.
axe-core zero violations on /onboarding and /settings/privacy
